early_retrieval.label: Early retrieval
early_retrieval.title: Demo 1 - Retrieval starts while the user is still speaking
early_retrieval.narration: The controller WAITs on the vague opening, RETRIEVEs as soon as the request is specific, and refines the search as more words arrive. The final answer is ready almost immediately after the user stops.

chunks.text: So I'm heading to Singapore next month
to visit a customer, and before I book anything
I'd like to know the daily meal allowance

multi_intent.label: Multi-intent
multi_intent.title: Demo 2 - One sentence, three searches, one grounded answer
multi_intent.narration: The Theme 4 guide's own example. One utterance becomes three sub-queries; the city is carried into each; they are retrieved in parallel, fused (a duplicate FAQ chunk is dropped) and answered with citations.

chunks.text: I need to plan a customer
and I need the cancellation policy and the catering options.

late_constraint.label: Late-arriving detail
late_constraint.title: Demo 3 - A late detail refines the answer (v1 -> v2) instead of restarting
late_constraint.narration: Turn 2 is classified as a refinement. Only the delta is searched; v1's claims and citations are kept; the late-booking and international rules are added as v2.

chunks.text: reimbursement rule for an employee trip.
and the booking was made after travel.

suppression.label: Retrieval suppression
suppression.title: Demo 4 - Presentation-only request: retrieval SUPPRESSED
suppression.narration: The second turn only asks to reshape the previous answer. The controller suppresses retrieval; the answer is rebuilt from session memory with the same citations.

abstention.label: Insufficient evidence
abstention.title: Demo 5 - Answer what the corpus supports, abstain on the rest
abstention.narration: The projector part is answered from the venue section; the wifi password is not in the corpus, so it is explicitly flagged instead of guessed.

chunks.text: Which Pune venue has a projector,
and what is the wifi password there?

abstention_full.label: Nothing in corpus
abstention_full.title: Demo 5b - Nothing relevant in the corpus: explicit abstention
abstention_full.narration: No claim is made; the uncertainty field names the terms the evidence does not contain.
